name: RiffleUpperV2.EmpiricalUpper.concreteExplorationTV
type:
∀ {k N L : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N (L + 1)),
  1 ≤ k →
    ∀ (hN : 2 ≤ N) (D B : ℕ),
      2 ≤ B →
        ∀ (g ξ η A r γ : ℝ),
          0 < g →
            0 < r →
              0 ≤ γ →
                RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.retainedGoodCluster cuts ⋯ D g →
                  RiffleLowerV2.maximalMean cuts ⋯ ≤ ↑N ^ (-η) →
                    A + 1 ≤ η * ↑B →
                      (RiffleUpperV2.probability (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                            fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                            ¬RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.concentrationEvent cuts D g ξ ω) ≤
                          r →
                        (∀ (p : Fin k) (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction),
                            ↑N ^ ξ ≤ ↑(RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p) →
                              ∀ i ≤ RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p,
                                ∀ (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
                                  (0 <
                                      RiffleUpperV2.probability (RiffleUpperV2.independentPairLaw cuts)
                                        fun (v : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) =>
                                        RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pairHistory cuts p d i v =
                                          RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pairHistory cuts p d i ω) →
                                    RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pairHistoryGood cuts D g ξ (√r) p d i ω →
                                      (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect (RiffleUpperV2.independentPairLaw cuts)
                                          (fun (v : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) =>
                                            ↑(RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.remainingDirectionalCount cuts D g ξ p d i v.1
                                                v.2))
                                          fun (v : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) =>
                                          RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pairHistory cuts p d i v =
                                            RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pairHistory cuts p d i ω) ≤
                                        γ) →
                          (RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.componentConstant B ^ (2 * k) - 1) * γ ≤ 1 / 2 →
                            RiffleUpperV2.tv (RiffleUpperV2.physicalInverseLaw cuts)
                                (RiffleUpperV2.uniformPermutation N) ≤
                              √(2 * (RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.componentConstant B ^ (2 * k) - 1) * γ) / 2 +
                                  (r + 2 * ↑N * √r + ↑k / 2 * ↑N ^ (ξ - η)) +
                                ↑N ^ (-A) / ↑(B + 1).factorial
